query:
SELECT EXISTS(
                SELECT 1
                FROM key_verifications kv
                WHERE kv.contact_id = ?
                    AND (kv.type != 'contactSharedByVerified'
                        OR EXISTS(
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM key_verifications verifier
                        WHERE verifier.contact_id = kv.verified_by
                    )
                )
            ) AS "value!: bool"
